summary: Snake covers the line-growing action-game lineage from Gremlin's 1976 Blockade through Nokia's culturally dominant 1998 mobile Snake.

entries.title: Snake
entries.definitive_edition: Blockade for 1976 origin; Nokia 6110 Snake for the culturally dominant named game

emulation.emulator: Arcade emulation or original Nokia hardware depending on branch
emulation.notes: Use original hardware where possible because controls/screen strongly affect play.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Blockade cabinet or Nokia 6110 handset with exact version documented

primary.version: Blockade origin route plus Nokia Snake cultural route
primary.why: The 1976 arcade game Blockade is the documented origin of the snake-game concept, while the 1998 Nokia 6110 Snake is the culturally dominant game actually titled Snake. A useful archive entry should label which branch is being captured rather than treating every Snake clone as identical.
primary.how_to_play: For origin history, document Blockade on original arcade hardware or accurate emulation. For the named popular route, use a Nokia 6110/compatible Nokia handset running Snake. Record platform, version, controls, speed, score, screen type, multiplayer/infrared state where applicable, and whether generic web/mobile clones were excluded.

secondary.exclusive_content: Culturally dominant mobile game titled Snake
secondary.what_to_play: Use for the recognisable single-player Snake route.
secondary.why: Blockade is the 1976 origin, but Nokia Snake is the famous named implementation.

all_releases.reason: primary: queue release year and historical origin.
skip: not the specific archive target unless separately queued.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Blockade is the origin route; Nokia Snake is the famous named mobile route. Generic clones should not be silently substituted.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record which branch is being archived and avoid generic clone substitution.
